title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Procedure for Chinese Citizens Applying for Recognition of Divorce Judgments Rendered by Foreign Courts

articles.content_en:
Article 1 A Chinese party may, in accordance with these Provisions, apply to the People's Court for recognition of a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court with which China has not concluded a judicial assistance agreement.
For a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court with which China has a judicial assistance agreement, application for recognition shall be made in accordance with the provisions of the agreement.

Article 2 These Provisions shall not apply to the recognition and enforcement of the parts of a foreign court's divorce judgment relating to the division of marital property, maintenance obligations, and child support.

Article 3 To apply to the People's Court for recognition of a foreign divorce judgment, the applicant shall submit a written application and shall attach the original of the foreign divorce judgment and a certified Chinese translation. Otherwise, the application shall not be accepted.

Article 5 The application shall be accepted by the Intermediate People's Court of the place of the applicant's domicile. If the applicant's domicile is different from his habitual residence, the application shall be accepted by the Intermediate People's Court of his habitual residence.
If the applicant is not within China, the application shall be accepted by the Intermediate People's Court of his original domicile in China.

Article 6 Upon receipt of the written application, the People's Court shall, after examination, file the case within seven days if the conditions for acceptance set forth in these Provisions are met; if not, it shall notify the applicant within seven days that the application will not be accepted, and shall state the reasons.

Article 7 The People's Court's examination of an application for recognition of a foreign divorce judgment shall be conducted by a collegial panel composed of three judges, and the ruling made shall not be appealable.

Article 8 After accepting the application, if the foreign divorce judgment does not indicate that it has taken effect or the date it took effect, the People's Court shall order the applicant to submit certification documents issued by the court that rendered the judgment, proving that the judgment has taken effect.

Article 9 If the applicant is the plaintiff who obtained the divorce judgment from the foreign court, the People's Court shall order the applicant to submit relevant certification documents proving that the foreign court that rendered the judgment lawfully summoned the defendant to appear in court.

Article 10 The certification documents required under Articles 8 and 9 shall be notarized by the foreign notarial authority and authenticated by the Chinese embassy or consulate in that country, or shall undergo the certification procedures provided for in the relevant treaty concluded between the People's Republic of China and that country. The applicant shall also provide a certified Chinese translation.

Article 11 If the applicant is the defendant in the foreign divorce judgment who resides within China and has difficulty submitting the certification documents and the notarization and authentication required under Articles 8 and 10, but can submit the notice of appearance or the summons from the foreign court, it may be presumed that the foreign divorce judgment is authentic and has taken effect.

Article 13 Recognition of a foreign divorce judgment shall be made by means of a ruling. If none of the circumstances specified in Article 12 exist, the ruling shall recognize its legal effect; if any of the circumstances specified in Article 12 exist, the ruling shall reject the applicant's application.

Article 14 The written ruling shall be made in the name of the "×× Intermediate People's Court of the People's Republic of China", signed by the members of the collegial panel, and affixed with the seal of the People's Court.
Article 15 The written ruling shall take legal effect upon service.
Article 16 When applying for recognition of a foreign divorce judgment, the applicant shall pay the case acceptance fee of RMB 100 yuan to the People's Court.

Article 17 If an applicant appoints an agent to apply for recognition of a foreign divorce judgment, a power of attorney signed or sealed by the principal must be submitted to the People's Court. If the power of attorney is executed abroad, it must be certified by the Chinese embassy or consulate in that country, or shall undergo the certification procedures provided for in the relevant treaty concluded between the People's Republic of China and that country.

Article 18 After the People's Court has accepted a divorce action, if the plaintiff changes the claim and applies for recognition of a foreign divorce judgment, or the defendant separately applies for recognition of a foreign divorce judgment, such application shall not be accepted.

Article 19 After the People's Court has accepted an application for recognition of a foreign divorce judgment, if the other party files a divorce lawsuit with the People's Court, the People's Court shall not accept it.

Article 20 Where the marriage between the parties has been adjudicated by a foreign court but no application for recognition has been filed with the People's Court, this shall not prevent either party from separately filing a divorce lawsuit with the People's Court.

Article 21 After the applicant's application has been accepted by the People's Court, the applicant may withdraw the application, and the People's Court shall grant the withdrawal by a ruling. After the applicant withdraws the application, the applicant shall not file another application, but may separately file a divorce lawsuit with the People's Court.

Article 22 After the applicant's application has been rejected, the applicant shall not file another application, but may separately file a divorce lawsuit with the People's Court.
